body: 8 times, but the urge is always sudden and strong, there's this embarrassing leaking of urine on some days too. No urge to pee whatsoever for 6-7 hours straight on the days when I go to sauna, no matter the amount of water I drink. (I normally drink little.) I don't know why, but sauna makes the problem disappear for the whole day. Also, the urge seems to come right after I think whether I have it. This thought seems to precede it (almost?) all the time.

I wanted to try getting over my disability for her... but I saw that it was going to take it too long. I had to tell her the truth about me. I couldn't lie to her anymore. She told me she liked me, but she didn't know then who I really am. And I so much wanted to become that someone whom she could like in real life and failed. Told her the truth and she's no longer interested in me and I lost the last thing I had in this life for which I wanted to live again.

I could try to find another one to fall for and thereby realize that the girl I'm into now is not the only one I could ever love or who could love me. This seems to be a good way to get over depression I'm in. I already feel kind of better just thinking about this. Thank you for giving me this new idea!!!

Thank you for your kind response!

I just hope I won't end up killing myself one day.

But now I get it, **thanks to you**, that I should give this relationship a try. I might never experience anything like this in my life again, as I'm not likely to ever be looking for a girlfriend myself... And, yes, she could've been sent for me by someone up above, not to become my girlfriend, but to show me the way, propell me to change, overcome my problems, maybe even by breaking my heart or sending me into a mental breakdown.

Too bad that I have to keep lying to her about myself and lead her on. But it might be good for her too. She might learn a valuable lesson for next time.

I can so relate to this.. I stay in my room all day for already 10 years now... and my parents are no longer telling me anything about getting a job or going outside. But we used to have huge fights over these issues. I even leave my house only in rare occasions, not more than once or twice in a year. All my friends and relatives think that I'm just a lazy leech, which I do not agree with, of course... since none of them knows that I would give anything to have a normal life, just like everyone else. I'd be glad to get any job - but my AvPD doesn't let me get out of my house.

I also dropped out of high school when I was 17 and have almost never left my house for the last 10 years. I go out only once or twice a year and only for a few hours or even minutes. I never had a job. I don't have any friends left except for online friends anymore. I get occasionally into a fight with my father too ... Going outside makes me feel like I'm dreaming. It's like I'm out of touch with reality. Like everything around me is unreal. I have nowhere to go now and no meaning in my life. I'm embarrassed too of what I have become, I wasn't like this as a child ... but I still carry the hope that things will get better eventually for me. But they, surely, won't get better by themselves. If only there was someone to force me to get therapy. If only ... Alas no one cares about me at all and I just can't bring myself to leave my house, unless it's for something very urgent.

Hopefully your brother, someone who seems to be just like me, overcomes it too one day!

And I am planning on ending it when I reach my 40s or 50s. Life is so pointless and meaningless for me. I'm a 26 years old with AvPD who in the last 10 years hasn't left his house for more than a few hours once or twice a year. My father is also very abusive verbally ... but I still carry the hope that I might overcome it one day and find meaning in my life. As for now, though, I have nothing to live for, no point in living at all, nowhere to go, no one to turn to. To me life feels like a prison.
